title: Parsing gigabytes of JSON per second
relevance: Describes simdjson's two-pass Stage 1 architecture that this concept aims to fuse into a single pass.

title: From Loop Fusion to Kernel Fusion: A Domain-Specific Approach to Locality Optimization
venue: IEEE/ACM International Symposium on Code Generation and Optimization (CGO)
relevance: Formalizes the kernel fusion problem for image processing pipelines. The graph partitioning approach to identify fusible operations applies to fusing JSON parsing stages.

title: Composing Distributed Computations Through Task and Kernel Fusion

title: Simdjson 4.3: Another 30% Speed Boost
